title: The iris pocket watch
alt: An antique gold pocket watch with a blue iris enamel lid.
description: A connected hinged object with enamel botanical decoration and an unnumbered dial.
prompt: A complete antique pocket watch with its decorated lid opened to the left and connected by a visible hinge. The circular face has a ring of simple evenly spaced marks and two hands connected at the centre, without numerals. The lid contains a delicate enamel iris flower with indigo petals and green leaves on ivory. A fine gold chain attaches to the top loop and coils naturally on dark velvet. Precise goldwork, believable watch thickness, exquisite macro photograph, no lettering.
